display.purpose: The live set's prescribed weight × reps; the largest thing on a logging screen.

headline.purpose: Exercise name above the live set; page headings (32px in the kit).

body-sm.purpose: Descriptions and overlay body; prose at 48-60ch.

label.purpose: Form and stepper labels, sentence case, Muted Ink.

label-sc.purpose: Section headings, set-kind badges (11px) and the live 'now' marker. Color from context; copper only on 'now'.

figures.purpose: Every set line: mono tabular weight, unit, ×, reps.

figures-stepper.purpose: The value inside a number stepper.

mark.purpose: 鍛錬 in the wordmark only.

shadows.name: shadow-color
shadows.purpose: The --shadow token every floater shadow is built on.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing: presses, hovers, field borders, dialog entry, the set-ruling moment.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet and its scrim entering (300ms).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every pressable; stepper − / + scale their icon to 0.85 instead.

motion.name: control-color
motion.purpose: Border, background and color shifts on hover and focus.

motion.name: dialog
motion.value: in 200ms scale 0.97 + fade; out 150ms scale 0.98 + fade
motion.purpose: Dialog keyframes; exits faster than entries.

motion.name: sheet
motion.value: in 300ms translateY(100%) on ease-drawer; out 200ms ease-out

motion.name: set-ruled
motion.value: 240ms ease-out, once: row settles 3px, copper rule draws outward, copper index cools to ink
motion.purpose: The one authored moment, when a set is logged. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

themes.mechanism: Each color token is one light/dark pair in src/index.css via the --if-light / --if-dark space toggles; prefers-color-scheme decides unless <html data-theme> (localStorage 'tanren-theme') pins it; any element may pin its own with data-theme.

narrative.overview:
Tanren's app world is the training log written as a lexicon entry: every set is a ruled, numbered line, written in order, the way a character is written stroke by stroke. Warm paper and warm near-black carry ink-colored type; hairline rules divide content instead of boxes; one copper accent marks the set happening now and the action that logs it. The surface is quiet so the numbers are loud: weights, reps and times sit in tabular mono at sizes a lifter can read from a bench.

Density is set by the gym, not the desk. Anything tapped mid-workout is a large target (44px floor, 56px for logging), the primary action sits in thumb reach, and nothing waits on the network: a set's state ("logged", "queued, no signal", "failed, retrying") is written into its line in words. Both themes are first-class and follow the device unless the lifter pins one.

The world comes from the home-page mockup "Stroke Order" (`design/mockups/7-stroke-order.html`). It rejects the fitness-app default: neon on black, progress rings, badges-as-rewards, gradient cards, streak confetti.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper / warm near-black, ink type, a single copper accent.
Ruled lines, not boxes; cards only where rows group, never nested.
Mono tabular numerals for every weight, rep and time; words in Albert Sans.
Large, flat, hairline-edged controls; press scales to .97.
One authored motion: a logged set is ruled into place, once, in 240ms or less.

rules.name: The One Copper Rule
rules.body: Copper means "this set, now" or "do it". It fills only the primary action and colors only the live set, plus the system-level focus ring, caret and selection. Badges, units, charts-in-app and status chips stay in ink.

rules.name: The Ghost Ground Rule
rules.body: On the Ghost Wash, text is Ink. Faint Ink and copper fall below 4.5:1 there.

rules.name: The Paired Token Rule
rules.body: A color exists as a light/dark pair in `src/index.css` or not at all. No raw hex in components; changing `--bg` also changes the two `theme-color` metas and the pre-paint script in `index.html`.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Every weight, rep, time and set index is Geist Mono with tabular figures, so 95 → 100 never shifts. Words never are: status text, labels and units-as-words stay in Albert Sans.

rules.name: The One Set Grammar Rule
rules.body: A set reads weight, small unit, ×, reps, in that order, everywhere: log, card, toast. Build it from the shared set-figures piece; never retype it.

rules.name: The Kanji Stay Home Rule
rules.body: 鍛錬 and Shippori Mincho appear only in the wordmark lockup (20px kanji, 13px "TANREN" at 700 with 0.22em tracking).

rules.name: The Thumb Floor Rule
rules.body: Anything a lifter taps mid-workout is at least 44px; logging controls are 56px. The 36px small button is for planning and settings screens only. Nothing anywhere is under 24px.

rules.name: The Only Floaters Cast Rule
rules.body: If it does not sit above a scrim or over the page, it has no shadow. Cards, buttons and fields are flat.

dos: Do keep copper on the primary action and the live set; everything else is ink, muted ink or a hairline.
Do set every weight, rep, time and index in Geist Mono tabular figures, and compose set lines from the shared weight / unit / × / reps grammar.
Do separate rows with 1px Hairlines and group them in a 12px Card Stock card only when they belong together.
Do give in-workout controls 56px (logging) or at least 44px, and keep the primary action within thumb reach.
Do write sync and set state in words next to an icon ("queued, no signal"), never in color alone.
Do use Edge (at least 3:1) for field boundaries and recheck contrast numerically in both themes when a token changes.
Do press-scale pressables to .97 with the ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) and keep overlay exits faster than entries; stop all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use neon on black, progress rings, reward badges, gradient cards or streak confetti.
Don't put copper on badges, units, status pills or decorative accents in the app.
Don't nest cards, or box individual rows that a hairline can rule.
Don't shadow anything that doesn't float above the page.
Don't use the tracked small-caps style for form labels; labels are sentence case at 14px.
Don't show the kanji or Shippori Mincho outside the wordmark lockup.
Don't use the 36px small button for anything tapped mid-workout.
Don't ship a shadcn/ui component stock; restyle it into these tokens first.

Don't bring the home page's marketing devices into the app: the stroke-order kanji diagram, copper emphasis inside headings, and copper small-caps labels belong to the Persuade surface (mockup 7), not to Operate screens.
